spinner: An open book seen from above: the right-hand page lifts, crosses the spine and lies down on the left, unhurried.
skeleton: A paragraph waiting for its type: a drop-cap block holds the first two lines aside, and a sienna wash soaks into each line and dries, one after another.
switch: A paper button in a recessed slot; on, the slot fills sienna and the button carries the printer's flower.
check: The tick a reader pencils in a margin, larger than its box and drawn bottom up; the radio is a sienna wax seal with the ring of its stamp pressed in.
toast: A slip laid in the book, set between a hairline and a double rule in serif italic, settling down from a slight turn like paper.
dialog: A page with its ornament: a fleuron between two hairlines above a serif italic title, framed by an inner rule, rising slowly into place.
tooltip: A gloss in the margin: serif italic beside a sienna rule, sliding in a few pixels as a note in a book would be read.
steps: The sections of a chapter, numbered with the section sign in serif italic, separated by middle dots; the current one sienna with a double underline.
empty: The blank page after the last chapter: a fleuron above an italic title, inside a ruled book-plate frame.
link: A thin sienna underline at rest; under the pointer the phrase is marked with a warm wash along the lower half of the words.
